summary: OpenAI's Codex CLI release notes describe adding GPT-6-Astra to the Amazon Bedrock model picker and fixing its guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize text-only input.

practices.reason: The tool-use guidance for GPT-6-Astra was corrected so that developers integrating it must use the supported tool and expect text-only clarification responses.
practices.quote: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only.

practices.reason: A new model was added to the Bedrock routing picker, a minor interface change for teams using that catalog.
practices.quote: Added GPT-6-Astra to the Amazon Bedrock model picker for Mantle and Runtime global/US routes.
